Our story

Between the mountains and the sea.

Lauhata was born in Liquiçá, on a coast where the mountains run down to the water. Here we welcome everyone the way family is welcomed in Timor-Leste: with time, a laid table and no rush.

[Add Lauhata's real story: who founded it, when it opened and what the name means.]

Experiences

A day at Lauhata

From the first coffee to the last plate — this is how a day goes here.

  1. 07:00

    Ermera coffee

    An unhurried breakfast while the sea is still calm.

  2. 10:00

    Sea and snorkelling

    Clear water and reefs along the Liquiçá coast.

  3. 13:00

    Lunch in the shade

    Catch of the day over the coals and coconut water.

  4. 15:30

    Discover Liquiçá

    The town, its history and the mountain villages.

  5. 18:00

    Sunset & dinner

    The best table in the house, as the sky turns gold.

Getting here

Along the coast road,
west of Dili.

A short, beautiful drive along the sea. If you need transport from Dili, get in touch.
